Gia (eng-security): Quick intake for vendor PT. Retest window Tue 09:00-13:00 UTC. Need: 1) ephemeral RBAC for assessors; 2) KMS decrypt gating for evidence; 3) audit export + retention. Also freeze window and rollback behavior. Can we confirm by Mon EOD?

Alex (eng-sre): We can create an assume-role `pt-assessor-temp` with s3:GetObject/List on `sec-evidence/pt-3812/*`. Max session 6h. Will require sts:TagSession with tag `pt_engagement=3812`.

Gia (eng-security): Sending vendor account IDs via DM. For KMS: prefer CMK condition on `aws:RequestTag/pt_engagement` so decrypt only works for tagged sessions. Any objections?

Alex (eng-sre): Makes sense. I'll add CMK condition and also issue a revocable KMS grant bound to role ARN for extra control.

Ruth (eng-ops): Logs plan: CloudTrail + app json + ALB -> s3://sec-evidence/pt-3812/raw/. Retention 90d hot, archive 1y. I'll run a redaction dry-run with synthetic data Tue 18:00 UTC and post a presigned sample.

Jared (eng-platform): Freeze Tue 07:00-15:00 UTC. Canary: auto-rollback if 5xx > 1% for 3m or p50 latency +150ms. Add fallback to smaller model. Ill publish runbook and calendar block.

sec-bot: Pen-test intake SEC-3812 created. Evidence bucket `redwood-pt-3812`. Dry-run redaction Tue 18:00 UTC. Oncall: @Alex. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/security/tickets/SEC-3812

Gia (eng-security): Owners: Alex = role + CMK grant + presigned manifest; Ruth = redaction + lifecycle + SIEM hookup; Jared = freeze + canary + runbook. Readiness check Mon 19:00 UTC in #eng-security. Final checklist: role ARN, KMS grant/policy, presigned manifest, redacted sample, lifecycle + CloudTrail, freeze calendar entry, evidence README. Flag blockers here. Thanks :)
